text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my way to the library
to do some research...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Could you take this with you
as well, please?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Mejiro Ramonu handed over were
several paperback books. All of them bore library
labels, showing they had been borrowed from the library.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I shall leave it in your capable handsââ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I assume she meant, "Please return this for me"...
I thought about asking why me, but――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whenever she gazes at me,
for some reason, the words just won't come out...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rushed on the spot, I blurted out something
that sounded just like an izakaya waiter!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: (I suddenly feel a chill down my spine...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Shocked by Mejiro Ramonu's words... I stood frozen for a while, unable to get the image of her eyes out of my head all day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The books handed to me were all novels praised for their masterful race depictions. So, on impulse, I brought up the topicââ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I wish rest days didn't even exist.
Just talking about it only makes the itch worse……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
With this body, with these legs,
I must reach out and touch itâ
